name: Guardian

abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Perfect Block: Bloklarken gelen tüm hasarı sıfıra indirir.
abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Kanama veya enerji hasarına bağımlı şampiyon kullanma. Zırhını kırmıyorsan/nötralize etmiyorsan özel saldırı kullanma — otomatik bloklar. Vigilance de otomatik bloğu önler.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Guardian can't land Critical Hits naturally, however every time he would have landed a Critical Hit, he inflicts an instant Shock dealing Energy Damage. This ability scales with Critical Damage Rating.
Guardian can trigger the Parry Mastery against non-contact attacks.

While all of Guardian's Abilities are below 100% Ability Accuracy for 3+ second(s), he inflicts a Shock Debuff, dealing [1,495.95] Energy Damage per second until restored. This ability scales with Base Attack only and cannot be affected by Ability Accuracy. Max 1 stack.

abilitySections.title: Armor Up
content: Start each fight with an indefinite Armor Up Buff, increasing Armor Rating by [2,750].
If this Buff is removed for any reason, it will return after 14 second(s).
While Guardian has an Armor Up, Well-Timed Blocks against Special Attacks grant 100% Perfect Block Chance over 0.5 second(s). Each Perfect Block grants 10% of a bar of Power.

abilitySections.title: Force Field
content: Force Field Charges last indefinitely, up to 3 Charges. Any additional Force Field Charges last for 22 seconds.
Gain 1 Force Field Charge every 12 seconds.

If Guardian has an Armor Up, gain a +15% chance per Force Field Charge to Auto-Block all Hits in the Opponent's Special Attack. Gain a +15% chance against Mutants. This Auto-Block can reach a 75% chance max and is considered a Well-Timed Block.
Consume 1 Force Field Charge(s) to Block Unblockable Special Attacks against Mutants.

abilitySections.title: On Fourth Light Attack
content: Consume 2 Force Field Charge(s), inflicting a Power Drain removing 20% of the Opponent's current Power.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: The first hit consumes 1 Force Field Charge(s) to gain an Armor Up Buff, increasing Armor Rating by [2,750] for 15 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: After activation, gain 3 Force Field Charge(s).
The last hit inflicts a Taunt Debuff for 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The first hit consumes all Force Field Charges, increasing Attack Rating by [12,466.25] for each Force Field Charge for the duration of the Special Attack.
If Guardian has 3+ Force Field Charges consume 1 Armor Up Buff, inflicting a Shock Debuff, dealing [24,932.5] Energy Damage over 3 second(s).
This attack cannot be Evaded by Mutant Champions.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: On activation, gain 6 indefinite Force Field Charge(s).
Inflict a Shock Debuff, dealing [14,959.5] Energy Damage over 20 second(s).
